uncertain.text: ταχυτής, ἡ. σφοδρότης καὶ ταραχή. κίγκλισις
uncertain.note: The stops after ἡ and ταραχή sit slightly high and could be a raised dot (ano teleia). I have written them as ordinary full stops, matching how the rest of the book is handled.
The double rho looks unmarked, but breathings on ρρ would be very small at this resolution.
